column1: # Everything NOT listed here is infrastructure (kitty, fish, fastfetch,
# ImageMagick, fzf, ripgrep, jq, nautilus-python, ...) and is always installed.
# `update apps` keeps its own install/remove catalog because it must also
# manage core packages (Firefox, Kitty) that this selection never offers.
#   key      stable identifier - stored in install-state.json, never a number
#   id       rpm package name, or Flatpak application ID
#   default  on = part of the Recommended preset, off = opt-in
#   group    Browsers | Media | Productivity | Utilities | Communication
# Keep lines ASCII. Comments and blank lines are ignored.
